en: Sepia-toned photograph of a large Baroque/early neoclassical civic building with a steep tiled roof and a tall, slender clock/bell tower rising from the center. The facade has evenly spaced rectangular windows framed by light pilasters. A staircase leads up to a central arched doorway topped by a sculptural figure and a small coat of arms. There is an open square in front, and overhead utility wires cross the sky.
